title: Place the complete 4x4 segmented NoC fabric
hypothesis: A compact endpoint-boundary harness can keep every payload bit, metadata field, VC FIFO, route branch, router instance, and inter-router link observable while allowing the complete 4x4 fabric to be placed as a macro without the artificial pin pressure of exposing all 16 endpoint buses.

direct_comparison.primary_question: How much timing, area, power, congestion, and synthesis complexity is added when the exact 16-router mesh and its links are placed together instead of composing one-router PPA?
include: clock-tree and routed-wire effects from aggregate placement

expected_benefit: replace the single-router-times-instance-count area floor with aggregate physical evidence
measure mesh wiring, congestion, buffering, and clock-distribution effects
bound whether the 4x4 topology remains physically plausible before Llama7B reranking
risks: the first point uses a deliberately loose 3.2 mm square die feasibility envelope and does not optimize die size
source and observation boundary registers add disclosed harness overhead
hierarchical synthesis may retain unobserved performance counters inside kept router modules; retained counter cost must be audited rather than assumed
the 16-router design may cross the known Yosys/OpenROAD runtime frontier

required_evaluations.objective: Measure first-pass Nangate45 hierarchical physical feasibility for the complete compact-boundary 4x4 segmented mesh.
required_evaluations.notes: Attempts 1 and 2 reused the same incomplete cached work row; attempt 2 completed run_sweep in 9.4 seconds and failed acceptance without invoking physical implementation.

required_evaluations.objective: Measure fresh Nangate45 hierarchical physical feasibility for the complete compact-boundary 4x4 segmented mesh after isolating it from the stale v1 cache.

expected_result.reason: A revision-specific FLOW_VARIANT must bypass the incomplete v1 cache and execute the full hierarchical physical flow.

required_evaluations.acceptance_notes: Require FLOW_VARIANT=mesh4x4_aggregate_r2 with independently retained ORFS provenance, all sixteen concrete routers and links, and complete finite PPA for promotion. Retain explicit bounded failures. Treat the compact traffic/observation boundary as disclosed harness overhead and do not claim workload-matched energy, SRAM placement, or HBM/DRAM evidence.

revision.replacement_contract: The revision-specific FLOW_VARIANT changes the parameter hash and ORFS directory so the evaluator must execute a fresh physical run.

required_evaluations.objective: Measure the aggregate 4x4 segmented mesh after making generic sweep cache reuse fail closed.

expected_result.reason: The unchanged r2 parameter path must be rejected as incomplete by the fixed cache gate and execute OpenROAD.

required_evaluations.acceptance_notes: Require the run log to report Re-running ineligible cached run for the retained r2 result, then execute OpenROAD. Require FLOW_VARIANT=mesh4x4_aggregate_r2 with exact new-source identity, retained finish/DEF provenance, all sixteen concrete routers and links, and complete finite PPA for promotion. Replace the prior parameter row rather than appending stale duplicates.

revision.replacement_contract: Keep the r2 parameter and result path intentionally unchanged; the source-aware complete-PPA cache gate must force the physical rerun.

required_evaluations.objective: Measure the aggregate 4x4 segmented mesh in a clean ORFS flow directory with self-contained failure evidence.

expected_result.reason: A new flow variant starts from a clean ORFS target; any failure must retain its return code, newest ORFS log tails, and result-directory inventory in result.json.

required_evaluations.acceptance_notes: Require FLOW_VARIANT=mesh4x4_aggregate_r4_diag, exact merged-source identity, and a new parameter-isolated ORFS directory. Promote only exactly one complete finite PPA row with retained finish/DEF, portable timing_debug_report.md path identity, and all sixteen concrete routers and links. On failure require make_returncode plus failure_evidence with the failing stage log tail; classify that row as explicit bounded evidence rather than silently retrying.

revision.replacement_contract: Use a clean revision-specific ORFS flow directory and the generic bounded failure-evidence transport merged in PR #1813.
